_help: Findings in the data generator and the fixes sent upstream, in page order. An item is shown only when its `event` (an id in site/events.json, which holds the URL, the server timestamp and the state) exists, so an item whose pull request is not posted yet stays off the page. `reply` quotes nothing: its text says what the reply did, within what the reply itself says.

items.finding: Patients with hypertension never got a kidney-function result.
items.detail: The wellness check tested a diagnosis code that no module has created since 2019.

items.finding: Kidney function was one CKD stage off, and end-stage patients got normal values.

reply.text: The emergency physician who had reported the kidney panel checked both findings, agreed, and said he will base his own fix on this one.

items.finding: The same seed produced different patients in different time zones.
People with hypertension and no diabetes were coded with diabetic kidney disease and given insulin.
items.note: The evaluation found this one: a model disagreed with the answer key on one record, and the record turned out to contradict itself. 826 of 9,883 adults were affected.
